blind.description: A stylized wall-mounted shop awning or canopy featuring a sturdy timber frame with diagonal support brackets and a draped fabric cover. The fabric has bold alternating stripes of burgundy red and cream with a scalloped front valance. The entire object floats above the ground as it is designed for wall mounting.
blind.from_above: A rectangular striped swatch of red and cream fabric bordered by brown wooden frame posts on the sides and a thick beam across the top, casting a prominent shadow.
defects: floating above the ground without a supporting wall
blind.height_vs_figure: The awning frame itself is about 2 to 2.5 feet tall and roughly 4 to 5 feet wide, hovering around 2 feet above the floor.
